svg.title: Errors the Agent Can Act On
svg.desc: A tool failure returns isError with a category: transient errors are retried, validation errors are fixed and resent, business-rule violations are explained to the customer, and permission errors are escalated; an empty result is a success.
svg.text: Errors the Agent Can Act On
isError plus a category tells the agent whether to retry, fix, explain or escalate.
Not an error: valid empty result
